title: 13.4: Xiling: Cryo-CMOS 18-bit Dual-DAC Manipulator with 4.6µV Precision and 4.1nV/Hz0.5 Noise Co-Integrated with the Single Electron Transistor at 60mK
problem: Silicon spin quantum bits and single-electron transistors require ultra-precise, ultra-low-noise gate voltage biasing at cryogenic temperatures (60mK) to achieve high-fidelity quantum gate control, but traditional room-temperature control electronics introduce excessive noise and require extensive cabling.
motivation: Scaling silicon spin qubits to millions requires fault-tolerant operation; precise multi-gate control (<10µV source-drain offset compensation) is critical for Elzerman readout and quantum state manipulation.
method: Xiling co-integrates (combines on the same chip) two independent ultra-precise voltage generators (18-bit dual-DAC—circuits that convert digital numbers into exact analog voltages) directly with the single-electron transistor at cryogenic temperatures (60mK). Normally, quantum chips require long cables to distant room-temperature electronics (300K), which introduces noise and signal degradation; this design keeps the voltage generators cold and on-chip to eliminate those problems. Special low-power circuits designed for extreme-cold operation deliver 4.6µV precision (18-bit level control) and 4.1nV/√Hz noise floor—the precision required for reliable quantum gate control.
key_novelty: Xiling places voltage control circuits directly on the quantum chip at cryogenic temperatures (60mK), eliminating the long cables and noise from remote room-temperature electronics, and achieving 4.6µV precision with 4.1nV/√Hz noise floor.
contributions: First cryo-CMOS DAC co-integrated with quantum device at 60mK
18-bit dual-DAC achieving 4.6µV precision for quantum gate control
4.1nV/√Hz noise floor suitable for high-fidelity Elzerman readout
Eliminates long cryogenic cabling, reducing noise and complexity
baselines: Room-temperature control electronics with cryogenic cabling
primary_theme: Cryo-CMOS co-integrated precision multi-gate manipulator for quantum dot control
